<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_BuildingHouse"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/building-house">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Requirements" name="Requirements or refinement"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Draft" name="Draft"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MaterialOrder" name="Material order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuildRequest" name="Request to build the house"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartyInvitation" name="Tree house party invitation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BuildingHouse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Builder" name="You" processRef="Process_Builder"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Architect" name="Tree house architect" processRef="Process_Architect"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Stores" name="Online stores"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialRequirements" name="Send requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Start_ArchitectRequest" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Refinement" name="Send refinement" sourceRef="Task_SendRefinement" targetRef="Start_ArchitectRequest" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Draft" name="Send draft" sourceRef="Task_SendDraft" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft" messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Order materials" sourceRef="Task_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Participant_Stores" messageRef="Message_MaterialOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuildRequest" name="Ask friends to build" sourceRef="Task_AskFriendsToBuild" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_BuildRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitation" name="Send party invitations" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_PartyInvitation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Builder" name="Build a tree house" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Building" name="Decide to build a tree house"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectRequirements" name="Collect requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to architect" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDraft" name="Receive draft" messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefineDraftFirst" name="Refine draft with additional requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRefinement" name="Send refinement to architect" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefineDraftAgain" name="Refine draft with additional requirements"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FurtherRefinement" name="Further refinement needed?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateMaterialsList" name="Create list of needed materials"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CategorizeMaterials" name="Categorize materials"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_OrderMaterials" name="Order materials from online stores" messageRef="Message_MaterialOrder"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelWorkSplit" name="Work while order is processed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitForOrder" name="Wait for order to be processed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AskFriendsToBuild" name="Ask friends to build the house" messageRef="Message_BuildRequest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildHouse" name="Build the house with friends"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelWorkJoin" name="Order processed and house built"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send tree house party invitations" messageRef="Message_PartyInvitation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateAttendeeList" name="Create list of party attendees"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuySnacks" name="Buy snacks for the party"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Building" name="Party snacks bought"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_01" sourceRef="Start_Building" targetRef="Task_CollectRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_02" sourceRef="Task_CollectRequirements" targetRef="Task_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_03" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_04" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDraft" targetRef="Task_RefineDraftFirst"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_05" sourceRef="Task_RefineDraftFirst" targetRef="Task_SendRefinement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_06" sourceRef="Task_SendRefinement" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_07" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDraft" targetRef="Task_RefineDraftAgain"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_08" sourceRef="Task_RefineDraftAgain" targetRef="Gateway_FurtherRefinement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_09" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FurtherRefinement" targetRef="Task_SendRefinement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_10" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FurtherRefinement" targetRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_11" sourceRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList" targetRef="Task_CategorizeMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_12" sourceRef="Task_CategorizeMaterials" targetRef="Task_OrderMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_13" sourceRef="Task_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelWorkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_14" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_WaitForOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_15" sourceRef="Task_WaitForOrder" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_16" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_AskFriendsToBuild"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_17" sourceRef="Task_AskFriendsToBuild" targetRef="Task_BuildHouse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_18" sourceRef="Task_BuildHouse" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_19" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelWorkJoin" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_20" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_21" sourceRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList" targetRef="Task_BuySnacks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Builder_22" sourceRef="Task_BuySnacks" targetRef="End_Building"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Architect" name="Prepare tree house draft" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ArchitectRequest" name="Receive requirements or refinement">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ArchitectRequest" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDraft" name="Prepare or revise draft"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDraft" name="Send draft" messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Architect" name="Draft sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Architect_01" sourceRef="Start_ArchitectRequest" targetRef="Task_PrepareDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Architect_02" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDraft" targetRef="Task_SendDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Architect_03" sourceRef="Task_SendDraft" targetRef="End_Architect"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
